evidence.name: Screen field: Size the image by screen
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Size the image by screen" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Size the image by screen
sections.description: Sizes the hero image as a percentage of the screen height (0 to 100%), so it scales with the device, the more responsive way to size a hero. If set, it overrides any fixed height above. A common starting point is 30 to 50% for a prominent banner that still leaves room for your title and button below; leave it empty to size by proportions instead.
